title: Knowledge Warriors: Card Battle
description: Enter an epic card battle inspired by Indian mythology! Wield powerful cards like Agni Blast, Saraswati's Blessing, and the legendary Brahmastra to defeat the Ignorance Imp and Doubt Dragon. Manage your mana, balance attack and defense, and use strategic combos to prove that knowledge is the ultimate weapon!
learning_objectives: Develop strategic thinking and resource management skills
Practice decision-making under pressure with limited resources
Learn about Indian mythology and its rich knowledge traditions
Understand cost-benefit analysis through mana and card trade-offs
Build pattern recognition skills by predicting enemy behavior

how_to_play.title: How to Play
steps: You start with 80 HP, 3 mana, and a hand of 5 cards drawn from your deck
Each turn, spend mana to play attack, defend, or skill cards from your hand
Attack cards deal damage to the enemy; defend cards add block to reduce incoming damage
Skill cards provide special effects like healing, drawing extra cards, or gaining mana
After your turn, the enemy attacks -- your block absorbs damage first, then your HP takes the rest
Defeat both enemies -- the Ignorance Imp and the Doubt Dragon -- to claim victory!
tips: Balance offense and defense -- going all-out attack leaves you vulnerable to big hits
Save high-cost cards for critical moments when you have enough mana
Use draw and mana-gain cards early to build momentum for powerful combos later
Pay attention to enemy attack patterns -- the Doubt Dragon hits harder every few turns
Healing is most efficient when you are low on HP -- do not waste it when nearly full

cards.name: Vidya Strike
cards.description: A focused strike fueled by the power of knowledge (vidya). The foundation of every warrior-scholar's arsenal.

cards.name: Kavach Shield
cards.description: An armour of disciplined study habits. Kavach means armour -- protect yourself with consistent learning.

cards.name: Agni Blast
cards.description: Channel the fire of Agni, the Vedic god of fire, into a searing attack that burns through ignorance.

cards.name: Vayu Dash
cards.description: A swift wind-blessed strike inspired by Vayu, god of wind. Quick and nimble -- deals damage and draws a card.

cards.name: Prithvi Wall
cards.description: Summon the steadfastness of Prithvi, Mother Earth. An immovable wall of resolve blocks incoming doubt.

cards.name: Saraswati's Blessing
cards.description: Invoke the wisdom of Goddess Saraswati to reveal hidden knowledge. Draw 2 cards and expand your options.

cards.name: Dhanvantari's Cure
cards.description: The divine physician Dhanvantari restores your vitality. Recover 12 HP through the ancient science of Ayurveda.

cards.name: Surya Flare
cards.description: Harness the radiance of Surya, the Sun God. A devastating solar flare that illuminates and destroys ignorance.

cards.name: Indra's Vajra Bolt
cards.description: Wield the legendary Vajra thunderbolt of Lord Indra. Strikes hard and the residual energy shields you.

cards.name: Shakti Surge
cards.description: Tap into the primordial energy of Shakti. Gain 3 bonus mana this turn to fuel a powerful combo.

cards.name: Vishnu's Preservation
cards.description: The Preserver shields you from harm and restores balance. Gain 20 block and heal 5 HP.

cards.name: Ganesh's Insight
cards.description: The Remover of Obstacles clears your mind. Draw a card and gain 1 mana -- a small but wise investment.

cards.name: Hanuman's Leap
cards.description: Channel the boundless energy of Hanuman! Leap into action dealing 10 damage and draw a card for your devotion.

cards.name: Brahmastra
cards.description: The ultimate celestial weapon created by Lord Brahma himself. Devastating, but costly -- use it only when victory is within reach.

cards.name: Yoga Nidra
cards.description: Enter the state of conscious sleep practiced by ancient yogis. Deep restoration heals 18 HP and grants clarity to draw a card.

enemies.name: Ignorance Imp
enemies.description: A mischievous creature born from laziness and distraction. It attacks with confusion and half-truths.

attack_pattern.message: Ignorance Imp charges a powerful Confusion Blast!
Ignorance Imp scratches you with Doubt Claws!

enemies.name: Doubt Dragon
enemies.description: A fearsome beast of self-doubt that grows stronger the longer you hesitate. Defeat it with confidence and strategy.

attack_pattern.message: Doubt Dragon unleashes a Crushing Despair breath attack!
Doubt Dragon feeds on your hesitation and grows stronger!
Doubt Dragon swipes with its Anxiety Tail!

glossary_terms.definition: The energy resource used to play cards. You gain mana each turn and can store up to a maximum of 10.
glossary_terms.example: A card costing 2 mana requires you to spend 2 of your available mana to play it.
glossary_terms.remember_tip: Mana = your energy budget each turn. Spend wisely!

glossary_terms.definition: Temporary defensive points that absorb incoming damage before your HP is reduced. Block resets each turn.
glossary_terms.example: If you have 10 block and the enemy deals 14 damage, you lose all 10 block and only 4 HP.
glossary_terms.remember_tip: Block is your shield -- it breaks first so your HP does not have to.

glossary_terms.definition: A card's rarity indicates how powerful and rare it is. Common cards are basic, while Legendary cards have the strongest effects.
glossary_terms.example: Brahmastra is a Legendary card dealing 35 damage, while Vidya Strike is a Common card dealing 8 damage.
glossary_terms.remember_tip: Common < Uncommon < Rare < Legendary -- rarer means stronger but costlier.

glossary_terms.definition: Drawing a card means adding a new card from your deck to your hand, giving you more options on future turns.
glossary_terms.example: Saraswati's Blessing lets you draw 2 cards, expanding your hand for better combos.
glossary_terms.remember_tip: More cards in hand = more choices = more power!

glossary_terms.definition: A legendary thunderbolt weapon wielded by Lord Indra in Hindu mythology, symbolizing indestructible power and determination.
glossary_terms.example: Indra's Vajra Bolt card is inspired by this mythological weapon.
glossary_terms.remember_tip: Vajra = diamond-hard thunderbolt that nothing can break.

win_conditions.description: Defeat both the Ignorance Imp and the Doubt Dragon without losing all your HP! Your score is based on remaining HP, turns taken, and cards played efficiently.

achievements.title: First Strike
achievements.description: Defeat the Ignorance Imp without taking any damage in the first turn

achievements.title: Divine Finisher
achievements.description: Defeat the Doubt Dragon using the Brahmastra card as the finishing blow

achievements.title: Untouchable Yogi
achievements.description: Complete a battle with more than 60 HP remaining

coaching_moment: Develop strategic thinking and resource management skills. Practice decision-making under pressure with limited resources.
cultural_context: Strategic thinking games have deep roots in Indian culture — from ancient Chaturanga (the predecessor of chess) to modern competitive gaming. Knowledge Warriors: Card Battle develops long-range planning and pattern recognition prized in Indian academic and professional settings.
reflection_prompt: Which card or play tested your patience the most? What did you learn about reading the table?
